title: Wooded Country House Close to Nashville
description:
Welcome to Nashville and country living! Parklike acres and a cozy home less than 20 minutes from downtown Nashville. Completely furnished with everything to make your stay relaxing and comfortable, including high-speed internet and cable TV.

The serenity of the private wooded lot is what we love the most. Whether you choose to grill out or enjoy quiet time on the patio, your view and surroundings will set the tone for a visit to one of the most special places in the U.S. You will love it!

The space
The house includes all the comforts of a quiet home in the country, plus amenities. In addition to a laundry room, an assortment of books and games, and an open floor plan, our guests also love the outdoor area with a large wooded backyard, replete with grill, patio and speakers.

Vaulted ceilings enhance the spacious living areas. Privacy and nature are at your doorstep. The nights are crazy quiet, with starry skies. Access to "It City" – with all of its entertainment and sports options – less than 20 minutes away.

Guest access
Access is via a coded lock. The code will be the last four digits of your phone number on record with AirBnB. Details will be provided by the day of your checkin. Check in is 3pm unless otherwise worked out beforehand (when possible).

Other things to note
- The garage is not available for guests use.

- The backyard is not fenced in.
